dashboard.label: AD Identity Attacks
dashboard.description: Detections for password spraying, brute force lockouts, and privileged group changes in lab.local

search.query: index=wineventlog EventCode IN (4771,4776,4625) | search NOT (EventCode=4776 Error_Code="0x0") | eval acct=coalesce(user, Logon_Account, Account_Name) | bin _time span=5m | stats dc(acct) AS accounts_targeted count BY _time | where accounts_targeted >= 10

index=wineventlog EventCode IN (4728,4732,4756) Group_Name IN ("Domain Admins","Enterprise Admins","Administrators","Schema Admins") src_user!="ANONYMOUS LOGON" | table _time EventCode src_user user Group_Name | rename src_user AS "Changed By", user AS "Account Added", Group_Name AS "Privileged Group"
